<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#f5f7fc; --bg-alt:#eef1fa; --surface:#ffffff; --ink:#10152b; --ink-soft:#5c6478; --line:#e1e5f2;
    --indigo:#c23c14; --indigo-dark:#3c34b5; --indigo-bg:#ffe6dc;
    --blue:#5a44e6; --blue-bg:#e7f0fe;
    --cyan:#0f766e; --cyan-bg:#e1f6fb;
    --pink:#c93a70; --pink-bg:#fde7f2;
    --mint:#0d9488; --mint-bg:#dff5f1;
    --amber:#d97706; --amber-bg:#fdf0dc;
    --red:#dc2626; --red-bg:#fde8e8;
    --gray:#6b7280; --gray-bg:#eef0f4;
    --radius:16px; --maxw:none;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{margin:0;font-family:"Inter",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--surface);line-height:1.55;}
  img,svg{max-width:100%;display:block;}
  a{color:inherit;}
  .wrap{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(24px,4vw,96px);}
  h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;line-height:1.12;margin:0 0 .5em;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.02em;}
  h1{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,4.6vw,3.55rem);}
  h2{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,3.6vw,2.6rem);}
  h3{font-size:1.25rem;margin-bottom:.5em;}
  h4{font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:.3em;}
  p{margin:0 0 1em;}
  section{padding:84px 0;}
  .section-white{background:var(--surface);}
  .section-tint{background:var(--bg-alt);}
  .section-dark{background:var(--ink);color:#e7e9f5;}
  .section-dark h2,.section-dark h3{color:#fff;}
  .section-gradient{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#a93312 0%,#c23c14 45%,#0f766e 100%);color:#fff;}
  .section-gradient h2{color:#fff;}
  .section-pricing{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f3eeff 0%,#e5f6fb 100%);}
  .lede{font-size:1.13rem;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:620px;margin-bottom:1.5em;}
  .section-dark .lede{color:#b6bcd8;}
  .section-gradient .lede{color:#efeaff;}
  .center{text-align:center;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}
  .eyebrow{display:inline-block;font-size:clamp(.92rem,1.5vw,1.02rem);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--indigo);margin-bottom:18px;}
  .section-gradient .eyebrow{color:#e6dcff;}
  .head-center{text-align:center;max-width:740px;margin:0 auto 46px;}
  .head-center .lede{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}

  code{font-family:ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,monospace;}

  /* Buttons */
  .btn{display:inline-block;padding:16px 30px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:800;text-decoration:none;font-size:.98rem;border:1.5px solid transparent;transition:transform .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;}
  .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .btn-primary{background:var(--indigo);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(79,70,229,.28);}
  .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--indigo-dark);box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(79,70,229,.34);}
  .btn-outline{border-color:var(--line);color:var(--ink);}
  .btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--indigo);color:var(--indigo);}
  .cta-note{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:10px;}
  .section-gradient .btn-primary,.final-cta .btn-primary,.section-pricing .price-card .btn-primary{background:#fff;color:var(--indigo);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(16,21,43,.22);}
  .section-gradient .btn-primary:hover,.final-cta .btn-primary:hover{background:#f2f4ff;}

  /* Header */
  header.site{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;background:rgba(245,247,252,.9);backdrop-filter:saturate(160%) blur(8px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  header.site .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding-top:14px;padding-bottom:14px;}
  .brand{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;}
  .brand span{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--indigo),var(--cyan));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
  header.site .btn{padding:10px 20px;font-size:.84rem;}
  .cta-link{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--indigo);text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--indigo-bg);text-underline-offset:3px;}
  .cta-link:hover{text-decoration-color:var(--indigo);}
  .section-gradient .cta-link{color:#fff;text-decoration-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);}
  .nav-links{display:flex;gap:24px;font-size:.86rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft);justify-self:center;}
  .nav-links a{text-decoration:none;}
  .nav-links a:hover{color:var(--indigo);}

  /* Hero */
  .hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:56px 0 60px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#eef1fc 0%,var(--surface) 78%);}
  .hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:48px;align-items:center;}
  .hero .wrap > div{min-width:0;}
  .blob{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(90px);opacity:.16;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;}
  .blob-1{width:520px;height:520px;background:var(--blue);top:-240px;right:-180px;}
  .tagline{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-style:italic;color:#0a6a79;font-size:1.05rem;margin:2px 0 16px;}
  .hero-actions{margin-top:26px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;align-items:center;}
  .trust-line{margin-top:22px;font-size:.86rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:600;}
  .trust-line b{color:var(--ink);}
  .trust-line span{margin:0 4px;color:var(--line);}
  .hero-visual{display:flex;justify-content:center;}
  .hero-stack{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;padding:20px 10px 30px;}
  .hero-page{position:absolute;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(16,21,43,.16);overflow:hidden;z-index:0;width:calc(816px * .28);height:calc(1056px * .28);}
  .hero-page .wb-embed{width:816px;transform:scale(.28);transform-origin:top left;}
  .hero-page-l{left:-6%;top:8%;transform:rotate(-9deg);}
  .hero-page-r{right:-8%;top:16%;transform:rotate(7deg);}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .hero-page{display:none;} }
  .hero-pin{position:absolute;left:-4%;bottom:-4%;z-index:2;width:168px;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 22px 44px rgba(16,21,43,.24);overflow:hidden;transform:rotate(-6deg);}
  .hero-pin-img{position:relative;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:2/3;}
  .hero-pin-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;}
  .hero-pin-scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to top, rgba(10,12,26,.8) 0%, rgba(10,12,26,.15) 45%, transparent 62%);pointer-events:none;}
  .hero-pin-save{position:absolute;top:9px;right:9px;background:var(--indigo);color:#fff;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.64rem;padding:6px 13px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(79,70,229,.35);}
  .hero-pin-headline{position:absolute;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:12px;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.92rem;line-height:1.28;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4);}
  .hero-pin-headline small{display:block;font-family:"Inter",sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:.62rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#e6dcff;margin-top:5px;}
  @media (max-width:640px){ .hero-pin{width:122px;left:-2%;bottom:-6%;} .hero-pin-headline{font-size:.74rem;} }
  @media (max-width:400px){ .hero-pin{display:none;} }

  /* ===== wb-embed: scoped, screen-adapted reproduction of the real workbook design system (workbook.css) ===== */
  .wb-embed{
    --radius:14px;
    font-family:"Inter",-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; line-height:1.55; font-size:10.6pt; color:var(--ink);
  }
  .wb-embed h1,.wb-embed h2,.wb-embed h3,.wb-embed h4{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 .4em;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-0.01em;}
  .wb-embed p{margin:0 0 .85em;}
  .wb-embed strong{color:var(--ink);}
  .wb-embed em{color:inherit;}
  .wb-embed a{color:var(--blue);}
  .wb-embed .content-wrap{max-width:100%;}
  .wb-embed .eyebrow{display:inline-block;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:8.2pt;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .wb-embed .eyebrow.indigo{color:var(--indigo);background:var(--indigo-bg);}
  .wb-embed .eyebrow.cyan{color:var(--cyan);background:var(--cyan-bg);}
  .wb-embed .rhythm{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:8pt;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:20px 0 8px;}
  .wb-embed .callout{border-left:4px solid var(--indigo);background:var(--indigo-bg);border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;padding:12px 16px;margin:14px 0;}
  .wb-embed .callout .cl-label{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:8.4pt;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--indigo);margin-bottom:4px;}
  .wb-embed .callout p{font-size:9.6pt;margin:0;color:var(--ink);}
  .wb-embed .callout.mint{border-color:var(--mint);background:var(--mint-bg);} .wb-embed .callout.mint .cl-label{color:var(--mint);}
  .wb-embed .worksheet{border:1.4px solid var(--indigo);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;margin:0;}
  .wb-embed .ws-bar{background:var(--indigo);color:#fff;padding:9px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:9.4pt;letter-spacing:.03em;}
  .wb-embed .ws-body{padding:16px 22px 6px;background:var(--surface);}
  .wb-embed .ws-group{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:9.6pt;color:var(--indigo-dark);margin:14px 0 8px;}
  .wb-embed .ws-group:first-child{margin-top:0;}
  .wb-embed .ws-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px;padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);font-size:9.4pt;}
  .wb-embed .ws-item:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .wb-embed .chk{flex:0 0 auto;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:3px;border:1.5px solid var(--ink-soft);margin-top:2px;}
  .wb-embed .field-label{font-family:"Inter";font-weight:600;font-size:9.4pt;color:var(--ink);margin:8px 0 3px;}
  .wb-embed .field-blank{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);min-height:18px;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .wb-embed .askai{border-left:4px solid var(--cyan);background:var(--cyan-bg);border-radius:0 var(--radius) var(--radius) 0;padding:14px 18px;margin:0;}
  .wb-embed .askai .ai-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:8.6pt;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cyan);margin-bottom:9px;}
  .wb-embed .prompt-card{background:#fff;border:1.4px dashed #a9dde8;border-radius:9px;padding:11px 15px;font-size:9.4pt;color:var(--ink);font-style:italic;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .wb-embed .prompt-label{font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:700;font-size:8.6pt;color:var(--cyan);text-transform:none;font-style:normal;margin-bottom:4px;display:block;}
  .wb-embed .ai-guard{font-size:8.8pt;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0;}
  .wb-embed table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:12px 0 18px;font-size:9pt;max-width:100%;}
  .wb-embed table th{background:var(--bg-alt);text-align:left;font-family:"Inter";font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:7.4pt;letter-spacing:.03em;color:var(--ink-soft);padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--line);}
  .wb-embed table td{padding:9px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top;color:var(--ink);}
  .wb-embed table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
  .wb-embed .triage-group{margin-bottom:14px;}
  .wb-embed .triage-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:9.4pt;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;margin-bottom:7px;padding-bottom:5px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--line);}
  .wb-embed .dot-lg{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .wb-embed .triage-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:5px 0;font-size:9.4pt;}
  .wb-embed table.rmap{font-size:8.8pt;}
  .wb-embed .week-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--indigo);color:#fff;font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:800;font-size:9pt;}
  .wb-embed .effort{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:5px;}
  .wb-embed .effort span{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line);}
  .wb-embed .eff-quick span:nth-child(1){background:var(--mint);}
  .wb-embed .eff-mod span:nth-child(1),.wb-embed .eff-mod span:nth-child(2){background:var(--amber);}
  .wb-embed .eff-sub span{background:var(--red);}
  .wb-embed .sec-pill{display:inline-block;background:var(--gray-bg);color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:700;font-size:7.4pt;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 8px;margin:1px 2px 0 0;}
  .wb-embed figure.diagram{margin:0;max-width:100%;}
  .wb-embed figure.diagram svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;}
  .wb-embed figcaption{font-size:8.6pt;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:10px;}
  .wb-embed .legend2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px 20px;margin-top:18px;}
  .wb-embed .leg-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px;font-size:9pt;}
  .wb-embed .leg-num{flex:0 0 auto;width:21px;height:21px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c23c14,#0f766e);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:800;font-size:8pt;}
  .wb-embed .leg-item b{display:block;color:var(--ink);}
  .wb-embed .leg-item span{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:8.2pt;}
  .wb-embed .cover2{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#000 0%,#c23c14 38%,#0e7fa6 78%,#0f766e 100%);position:relative;height:11in;width:8.5in;overflow:hidden;border-radius:22px;}
  .wb-embed .cover2-grid{position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.10) 1px, transparent 1px);background-size:22px 22px;opacity:.5;}
  .wb-embed .cover2-stage{position:relative;height:8.6in;padding:.9in .85in 0;color:#fff;}
  .wb-embed .c2-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 13px 5px 9px;font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:700;font-size:8.6pt;letter-spacing:.03em;}
  .wb-embed .c2-eyebrow .sw{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#bcd7ff);display:inline-block;}
  .wb-embed .c2-h1{font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:800;font-size:38pt;line-height:1.03;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:20px 0 12px;}
  .wb-embed .c2-h1 .accent{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#bcd7ff,#a6f3e6);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
  .wb-embed .c2-sub{font-size:13pt;color:#dbe3ff;font-weight:500;max-width:4.3in;}
  .wb-embed .c2-card{position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(16,21,43,.34);padding:12px 14px;color:var(--ink);}
  .wb-embed .c2-card h5{font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:800;font-size:7.4pt;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0 0 6px;}
  .wb-embed .card-kw{top:1.15in;right:.5in;width:2in;transform:rotate(4deg);}
  .wb-embed .card-kw .row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:8pt;padding:2px 0;color:var(--ink);}
  .wb-embed .card-kw .row span.d{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--indigo);flex:0 0 auto;}
  .wb-embed .card-arch{top:3.35in;right:1.65in;width:2in;transform:rotate(-6deg);}
  .wb-embed .card-arch svg{width:100%;height:60px;display:block;}
  .wb-embed .card-chk{top:2.6in;right:-.2in;width:1.65in;transform:rotate(9deg);}
  .wb-embed .card-chk .ci{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:7.8pt;padding:2px 0;}
  .wb-embed .card-chk .ci .b{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--mint);flex:0 0 auto;position:relative;}
  .wb-embed .card-chk .ci .b::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:3px;top:1px;width:4px;height:6px;border:solid #fff;border-width:0 2px 2px 0;transform:rotate(40deg);}
  .wb-embed .card-serp{top:5.3in;right:.65in;width:2.3in;transform:rotate(-3deg);}
  .wb-embed .card-serp .url{font-size:6.4pt;color:var(--mint);margin-bottom:2px;}
  .wb-embed .card-serp .t{font-size:8.4pt;color:var(--blue);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:3px;}
  .wb-embed .card-serp .d{font-size:7pt;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .wb-embed .cover2-base{background:var(--surface);padding:.4in .85in;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;position:relative;z-index:2;height:1.4in;}
  .wb-embed .wordmark{font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:800;font-size:14pt;}
  .wb-embed .wordmark .seo{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--indigo),var(--cyan));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
  .wb-embed .cover2-stats{display:flex;gap:20px;}
  .wb-embed .c2-stat{text-align:right;}
  .wb-embed .c2-stat b{display:block;font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:800;color:var(--indigo);font-size:11pt;}
  .wb-embed .c2-stat small{font-size:6.6pt;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;}

  /* thumb frames that host wb-embed content at real-page fidelity, scaled to fit the sales page */
  .wb-cover-thumb{--wbs:.4;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:22px;width:calc(816px * var(--wbs));height:calc(1056px * var(--wbs));flex:0 0 auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 30px 60px rgba(16,21,43,.35));}
  .wb-cover-thumb .wb-embed{width:816px;transform:scale(var(--wbs));transform-origin:top left;}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .wb-cover-thumb{--wbs:.33;} }
  @media (max-width:520px){ .wb-cover-thumb{--wbs:.29;margin:0 auto;} }

  .wb-thumb{--wbs:.7;--wn:700px;--hn:480px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;width:min(calc(var(--wn) * var(--wbs)), 88vw);height:calc(var(--hn) * var(--wbs));border-radius:18px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 20px 44px rgba(16,21,43,.14);border:1px solid var(--line);flex:0 0 auto;}
  .wb-thumb .wb-embed{width:var(--wn);transform:scale(var(--wbs));transform-origin:top left;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;}
  .wb-thumb .wb-embed-pad{padding:24px;padding-top:104px;}
  .wb-thumb .wb-fade{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:60px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,255,255,0), #fff);pointer-events:none;}
  .wb-thumb .wb-tag{position:absolute;top:13px;left:13px;z-index:5;background:rgba(16,21,43,.82);color:#fff;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.64rem;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 11px;border-radius:999px;}
  @media (max-width:640px){ .wb-thumb{--wbs:.56;} }
  @media (max-width:400px){ .wb-thumb{--wbs:.44;} }
  /* stacked-paper depth treatment for the two payoff pages (90-day plan / final plan) */
  .thumb-stack{position:relative;display:inline-block;}
  .thumb-stack::before,.thumb-stack::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;z-index:0;}
  .thumb-stack::before{transform:rotate(-1.6deg) translate(-5px,7px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(16,21,43,.08);}
  .thumb-stack::after{transform:rotate(1.8deg) translate(6px,4px);box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(16,21,43,.07);}
  .thumb-stack .wb-thumb{position:relative;z-index:1;}
  .thumb-stack.block{display:block;width:100%;}

  /* ===== Problem: asymmetric split, scattered chaos → order ===== */
  .problem-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:56px;align-items:center;}
  .problem-split > div{min-width:0;}
  .problem-split .lede{margin-left:0;margin-right:0;}
  .problem-visual{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;}
  .search-mock{width:100%;max-width:420px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(16,21,43,.12);overflow:hidden;}
  .search-mock-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:18px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .search-mock-bar span{font-size:1rem;color:var(--ink);font-weight:500;}
  .search-mock-bar .cursor{display:inline-block;width:1.5px;height:17px;background:var(--indigo);margin-left:2px;vertical-align:-3px;}
  .search-suggestions{padding:6px 0;}
  .sg-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 20px;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .sg-row svg{flex:0 0 auto;opacity:.55;}
  .sg-row b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;}
  .search-mock-caption{margin-top:18px;font-size:.86rem;color:var(--ink-soft);text-align:center;}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .problem-split{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px;} }
  .search-flow{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:22px;max-width:460px;}
  .sf-step{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;text-align:center;flex:1;}
  .sf-icon{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--indigo-bg);color:var(--indigo);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .sf-step span{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.3;}
  .sf-arrow{color:var(--line);font-size:1.1rem;flex:0 0 auto;margin-top:10px;}

  /* ===== 9-stage system diagram ===== */
  .sys-track{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:60px;flex-wrap:wrap;row-gap:32px;}
  .sys-track::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:23px;left:3%;right:3%;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--indigo),var(--cyan));z-index:0;}
  .sys-node{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;text-align:center;padding:0 4px;}
  .sys-dot{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:2.5px solid var(--indigo);color:var(--indigo);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.92rem;}
  .sys-node.final .sys-dot{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--indigo),var(--cyan));border-color:transparent;color:#fff;width:52px;height:52px;font-size:1.3rem;}
  .sys-label{margin-top:10px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.3;}
  .sys-node.final .sys-label{color:var(--ink);font-weight:800;}
  @media (max-width:900px){
    .sys-track{justify-content:flex-start;column-gap:8px;}
    .sys-track::before{display:none;}
    .sys-node{flex:0 0 calc(33.333% - 6px);}
  }

  /* ===== Two-worked-example diagrams: Pinterest Trends + Board Architecture ===== */
  .dual-diagram{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px;margin-top:64px;}
  .diagram-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:26px 24px 22px;text-align:left;}
  .diagram-card h4{font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .diagram-card .dc-note{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:16px;}
  .diagram-card svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;}
  .diagram-legend{display:flex;gap:16px;margin-top:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .diagram-legend span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:600;}
  .diagram-legend i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;display:inline-block;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .dc-callout{margin-top:16px;background:var(--mint-bg);border-left:3px solid var(--mint);border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;padding:10px 14px;font-size:.8rem;color:#0a5c53;}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .dual-diagram{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }

  /* ===== Built gallery ===== */
  .gallery-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:28px;justify-content:center;margin-top:8px;}
  .gallery-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;max-width:calc(var(--wn,700px) * var(--wbs,.62));}
  .gallery-item h4{font-size:.98rem;text-align:center;}
  .gallery-item p{font-size:.84rem;color:var(--ink-soft);text-align:center;max-width:280px;margin:0;}

  /* ===== Ask AI section ===== */
  .copilot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:52px;align-items:center;}
  .copilot-grid > div{min-width:0;}
  .copilot-note{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:22px 26px;margin-top:18px;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .copilot-note b{color:var(--ink);}

  /* ===== Scattered advice -> one plan (simplified) ===== */
  .scatter-plan{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;gap:32px;align-items:center;margin-top:48px;}
  .sp-sources{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;align-content:start;}
  .sp-source{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:13px 14px;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:.86rem;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .sp-dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .sp-arrow-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-align:center;}
  .sp-label{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-soft);white-space:nowrap;}
  .sp-label-final{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#c23c14,#0f766e);color:#fff;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:999px;}
  .sp-arrow-big{color:var(--line);font-size:1.9rem;line-height:1;}
  .sp-result{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:30px 26px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 20px 44px rgba(16,21,43,.1);}
  .sp-result .sr-icon{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#c23c14,#0f766e);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 14px;box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(79,70,229,.28);}
  .sp-result b{display:block;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .sp-result .sr-sub{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .sp-tags{margin-top:16px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:700;}
  @media (max-width:800px){
    .scatter-plan{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px;}
    .sp-arrow-col{flex-direction:row;justify-content:center;}
    .sp-arrow-big{transform:rotate(90deg);}
  }

  /* ===== finished artifact ===== */
  .finished-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:32px;align-items:start;}
  .finished-grid > div{min-width:0;}
  .finished-grid .wb-thumb{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;}

  /* ===== fit split (who it's for), reused pattern ===== */
  .fit-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;gap:56px;align-items:start;}
  .fit-split > div{min-width:0;}
  .fit-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;align-items:stretch;}
  .fit-usecase{border-radius:var(--radius);padding:24px 22px;border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%;box-sizing:border-box;}
  .fit-usecase .fu-icon{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.6);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .fit-usecase p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0;flex:1 1 auto;}
  .fit-usecase b{display:block;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px;}
  .not-for{margin-top:22px;padding:18px 20px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);}
  .not-for h4{margin-bottom:8px;}
  .not-for ul{margin:0;padding-left:20px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.88rem;}

  /* ===== Price ===== */
  .price-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:40px 44px 34px;margin:16px auto 0;max-width:600px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(16,21,43,.1);}
  .price-list{list-style:none;margin:0 0 22px;padding:0;text-align:left;}
  .price-list li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bg-alt);font-size:.96rem;}
  .price-list li:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .price-list .chk2{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--mint-bg);color:var(--mint);font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .price-amount{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--indigo-bg),var(--cyan-bg));border-radius:16px;padding:26px 20px 30px;margin-bottom:22px;}
  .price-amount span{font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.84rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .price-amount b{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-size:clamp(3rem,6vw,3.8rem);color:var(--indigo);line-height:1;}
  .price-amount .sub{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:600;margin-top:8px;}
  .delivery-note{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;background:var(--bg-alt);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;margin-top:22px;font-size:.84rem;color:var(--ink-soft);text-align:left;}

  /* ===== Ladder ===== */
  .ladder{display:flex;gap:0;margin:20px auto 0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;max-width:760px;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(16,21,43,.05);}
  .ladder-step{flex:1;padding:30px 28px;background:var(--surface);position:relative;}
  .ladder-step + .ladder-step{border-left:1px solid var(--line);}
  .ladder-step.active{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--indigo-bg),#fff 70%);}
  .ladder-step .ls-tag{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--indigo);margin-bottom:10px;}
  .ladder-step.step-analyze .ls-tag{color:var(--cyan);}
  .ladder-step .ls-price{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:1.7rem;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px;}
  .ladder-step p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0 0 16px;}
  @media (max-width:700px){ .ladder{flex-direction:column;} .ladder-step + .ladder-step{border-left:none;border-top:1px solid var(--line);} }

  /* FAQ */
  .faq-list{max-width:740px;margin:0 auto;}

        <h2>You Need More Traffic. You Don't Want to Pay for Every Click.</h2>
        <p class="lede">Paid traffic stops the moment you stop paying for it. Pinterest search results become useful only when each image is published as a complete Pin—with a title, destination link, description, and useful visual. Pinterest gives certain businesses another way to get discovered — by people who are already searching, planning, comparing, and saving ideas, not being interrupted by an ad.</p>

    --cyan:#0f766e; --cyan-bg:#e1f6fb;
    --pink:#c93a70; --pink-bg:#fde7f2;
    --mint:#0d9488; --mint-bg:#dff5f1;
    --amber:#d97706; --amber-bg:#fdf0dc;
    --red:#dc2626; --red-bg:#fde8e8;
    --gray:#6b7280; --gray-bg:#eef0f4;
    --radius:16px; --maxw:none;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{margin:0;font-family:"Inter",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--surface);line-height:1.55;}
  img,svg{max-width:100%;display:block;}
  a{color:inherit;}
  .wrap{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(24px,4vw,96px);}
  h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;line-height:1.12;margin:0 0 .5em;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.02em;}
  h1{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,4.6vw,3.55rem);}
  h2{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,3.6vw,2.6rem);}
  h3{font-size:1.25rem;margin-bottom:.5em;}
  h4{font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:.3em;}
  p{margin:0 0 1em;}
  section{padding:84px 0;}
  .section-white{background:var(--surface);}
  .section-tint{background:var(--bg-alt);}
  .section-dark{background:var(--ink);color:#e7e9f5;}
  .section-dark h2,.section-dark h3{color:#fff;}
  .section-gradient{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#a93312 0%,#c23c14 45%,#0f766e 100%);color:#fff;}
  .section-gradient h2{color:#fff;}
  .section-pricing{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f3eeff 0%,#e5f6fb 100%);}
  .lede{font-size:1.13rem;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:620px;margin-bottom:1.5em;}
  .section-dark .lede{color:#b6bcd8;}
  .section-gradient .lede{color:#efeaff;}
  .center{text-align:center;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}
  .eyebrow{display:inline-block;font-size:clamp(.92rem,1.5vw,1.02rem);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--indigo);margin-bottom:18px;}
  .section-gradient .eyebrow{color:#e6dcff;}
  .head-center{text-align:center;max-width:740px;margin:0 auto 46px;}
  .head-center .lede{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}

  code{font-family:ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,monospace;}

  /* Buttons */
  .btn{display:inline-block;padding:16px 30px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:800;text-decoration:none;font-size:.98rem;border:1.5px solid transparent;transition:transform .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;}
  .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .btn-primary{background:var(--indigo);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(79,70,229,.28);}
  .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--indigo-dark);box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(79,70,229,.34);}
  .btn-outline{border-color:var(--line);color:var(--ink);}
  .btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--indigo);color:var(--indigo);}
  .cta-note{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:10px;}
  .section-gradient .btn-primary,.final-cta .btn-primary,.section-pricing .price-card .btn-primary{background:#fff;color:var(--indigo);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(16,21,43,.22);}
  .section-gradient .btn-primary:hover,.final-cta .btn-primary:hover{background:#f2f4ff;}

  /* Header */
  header.site{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;background:rgba(245,247,252,.9);backdrop-filter:saturate(160%) blur(8px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  header.site .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding-top:14px;padding-bottom:14px;}
  .brand{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;}
  .brand span{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--indigo),var(--cyan));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
  header.site .btn{padding:10px 20px;font-size:.84rem;}
  .cta-link{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--indigo);text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--indigo-bg);text-underline-offset:3px;}
  .cta-link:hover{text-decoration-color:var(--indigo);}
  .section-gradient .cta-link{color:#fff;text-decoration-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);}
  .nav-links{display:flex;gap:24px;font-size:.86rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft);justify-self:center;}
  .nav-links a{text-decoration:none;}
  .nav-links a:hover{color:var(--indigo);}

  /* Hero */
  .hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:56px 0 60px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#eef1fc 0%,var(--surface) 78%);}
  .hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:48px;align-items:center;}
  .hero .wrap > div{min-width:0;}
  .blob{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(90px);opacity:.16;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;}
  .blob-1{width:520px;height:520px;background:var(--blue);top:-240px;right:-180px;}
  .tagline{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-style:italic;color:#0a6a79;font-size:1.05rem;margin:2px 0 16px;}
  .hero-actions{margin-top:26px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;align-items:center;}
  .trust-line{margin-top:22px;font-size:.86rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:600;}
  .trust-line b{color:var(--ink);}
  .trust-line span{margin:0 4px;color:var(--line);}
  .hero-visual{display:flex;justify-content:center;}
  .hero-stack{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;padding:20px 10px 30px;}
  .hero-page{position:absolute;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(16,21,43,.16);overflow:hidden;z-index:0;width:calc(816px * .28);height:calc(1056px * .28);}
  .hero-page .wb-embed{width:816px;transform:scale(.28);transform-origin:top left;}
  .hero-page-l{left:-6%;top:8%;transform:rotate(-9deg);}
  .hero-page-r{right:-8%;top:16%;transform:rotate(7deg);}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .hero-page{display:none;} }
  .hero-pin{position:absolute;left:-4%;bottom:-4%;z-index:2;width:168px;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 22px 44px rgba(16,21,43,.24);overflow:hidden;transform:rotate(-6deg);}
  .hero-pin-img{position:relative;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:2/3;}
  .hero-pin-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;}
  .hero-pin-scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to top, rgba(10,12,26,.8) 0%, rgba(10,12,26,.15) 45%, transparent 62%);pointer-events:none;}
  .hero-pin-save{position:absolute;top:9px;right:9px;background:var(--indigo);color:#fff;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.64rem;padding:6px 13px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(79,70,229,.35);}
  .hero-pin-headline{position:absolute;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:12px;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.92rem;line-height:1.28;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4);}
  .hero-pin-headline small{display:block;font-family:"Inter",sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:.62rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#e6dcff;margin-top:5px;}
  @media (max-width:640px){ .hero-pin{width:122px;left:-2%;bottom:-6%;} .hero-pin-headline{font-size:.74rem;} }
  @media (max-width:400px){ .hero-pin{display:none;} }

  /* ===== wb-embed: scoped, screen-adapted reproduction of the real workbook design system (workbook.css) ===== */
  .wb-embed{
    --radius:14px;
    font-family:"Inter",-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; line-height:1.55; font-size:10.6pt; color:var(--ink);
  }
  .wb-embed h1,.wb-embed h2,.wb-embed h3,.wb-embed h4{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 .4em;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-0.01em;}
  .wb-embed p{margin:0 0 .85em;}
  .wb-embed strong{color:var(--ink);}
  .wb-embed em{color:inherit;}
  .wb-embed a{color:var(--blue);}
  .wb-embed .content-wrap{max-width:100%;}
  .wb-embed .eyebrow{display:inline-block;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:8.2pt;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .wb-embed .eyebrow.indigo{color:var(--indigo);background:var(--indigo-bg);}
  .wb-embed .eyebrow.cyan{color:var(--cyan);background:var(--cyan-bg);}
  .wb-embed .rhythm{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:8pt;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:20px 0 8px;}
  .wb-embed .callout{border-left:4px solid var(--indigo);background:var(--indigo-bg);border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;padding:12px 16px;margin:14px 0;}
  .wb-embed .callout .cl-label{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:8.4pt;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--indigo);margin-bottom:4px;}
  .wb-embed .callout p{font-size:9.6pt;margin:0;color:var(--ink);}
  .wb-embed .callout.mint{border-color:var(--mint);background:var(--mint-bg);} .wb-embed .callout.mint .cl-label{color:var(--mint);}
  .wb-embed .worksheet{border:1.4px solid var(--indigo);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;margin:0;}
  .wb-embed .ws-bar{background:var(--indigo);color:#fff;padding:9px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:9.4pt;letter-spacing:.03em;}
  .wb-embed .ws-body{padding:16px 22px 6px;background:var(--surface);}
  .wb-embed .ws-group{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:9.6pt;color:var(--indigo-dark);margin:14px 0 8px;}
  .wb-embed .ws-group:first-child{margin-top:0;}
  .wb-embed .ws-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px;padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);font-size:9.4pt;}
  .wb-embed .ws-item:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .wb-embed .chk{flex:0 0 auto;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:3px;border:1.5px solid var(--ink-soft);margin-top:2px;}
  .wb-embed .field-label{font-family:"Inter";font-weight:600;font-size:9.4pt;color:var(--ink);margin:8px 0 3px;}
  .wb-embed .field-blank{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);min-height:18px;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .wb-embed .askai{border-left:4px solid var(--cyan);background:var(--cyan-bg);border-radius:0 var(--radius) var(--radius) 0;padding:14px 18px;margin:0;}
  .wb-embed .askai .ai-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:8.6pt;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cyan);margin-bottom:9px;}
  .wb-embed .prompt-card{background:#fff;border:1.4px dashed #a9dde8;border-radius:9px;padding:11px 15px;font-size:9.4pt;color:var(--ink);font-style:italic;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .wb-embed .prompt-label{font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:700;font-size:8.6pt;color:var(--cyan);text-transform:none;font-style:normal;margin-bottom:4px;display:block;}
  .wb-embed .ai-guard{font-size:8.8pt;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0;}
  .wb-embed table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:12px 0 18px;font-size:9pt;max-width:100%;}
  .wb-embed table th{background:var(--bg-alt);text-align:left;font-family:"Inter";font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:7.4pt;letter-spacing:.03em;color:var(--ink-soft);padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--line);}
  .wb-embed table td{padding:9px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top;color:var(--ink);}
  .wb-embed table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
  .wb-embed .triage-group{margin-bottom:14px;}
  .wb-embed .triage-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:9.4pt;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;margin-bottom:7px;padding-bottom:5px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--line);}
  .wb-embed .dot-lg{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .wb-embed .triage-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:5px 0;font-size:9.4pt;}
  .wb-embed table.rmap{font-size:8.8pt;}
  .wb-embed .week-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--indigo);color:#fff;font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:800;font-size:9pt;}
  .wb-embed .effort{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:5px;}
  .wb-embed .effort span{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line);}
  .wb-embed .eff-quick span:nth-child(1){background:var(--mint);}
  .wb-embed .eff-mod span:nth-child(1),.wb-embed .eff-mod span:nth-child(2){background:var(--amber);}
  .wb-embed .eff-sub span{background:var(--red);}
  .wb-embed .sec-pill{display:inline-block;background:var(--gray-bg);color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:700;font-size:7.4pt;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 8px;margin:1px 2px 0 0;}
  .wb-embed figure.diagram{margin:0;max-width:100%;}
  .wb-embed figure.diagram svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;}
  .wb-embed figcaption{font-size:8.6pt;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:10px;}
  .wb-embed .legend2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px 20px;margin-top:18px;}
  .wb-embed .leg-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px;font-size:9pt;}
  .wb-embed .leg-num{flex:0 0 auto;width:21px;height:21px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c23c14,#0f766e);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:800;font-size:8pt;}
  .wb-embed .leg-item b{display:block;color:var(--ink);}
  .wb-embed .leg-item span{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:8.2pt;}
  .wb-embed .cover2{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#000 0%,#c23c14 38%,#0e7fa6 78%,#0f766e 100%);position:relative;height:11in;width:8.5in;overflow:hidden;border-radius:22px;}
  .wb-embed .cover2-grid{position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.10) 1px, transparent 1px);background-size:22px 22px;opacity:.5;}
  .wb-embed .cover2-stage{position:relative;height:8.6in;padding:.9in .85in 0;color:#fff;}
  .wb-embed .c2-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 13px 5px 9px;font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:700;font-size:8.6pt;letter-spacing:.03em;}
  .wb-embed .c2-eyebrow .sw{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#bcd7ff);display:inline-block;}
  .wb-embed .c2-h1{font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:800;font-size:38pt;line-height:1.03;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:20px 0 12px;}
  .wb-embed .c2-h1 .accent{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#bcd7ff,#a6f3e6);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
  .wb-embed .c2-sub{font-size:13pt;color:#dbe3ff;font-weight:500;max-width:4.3in;}
  .wb-embed .c2-card{position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(16,21,43,.34);padding:12px 14px;color:var(--ink);}
  .wb-embed .c2-card h5{font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:800;font-size:7.4pt;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0 0 6px;}
  .wb-embed .card-kw{top:1.15in;right:.5in;width:2in;transform:rotate(4deg);}
  .wb-embed .card-kw .row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:8pt;padding:2px 0;color:var(--ink);}
  .wb-embed .card-kw .row span.d{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--indigo);flex:0 0 auto;}
  .wb-embed .card-arch{top:3.35in;right:1.65in;width:2in;transform:rotate(-6deg);}
  .wb-embed .card-arch svg{width:100%;height:60px;display:block;}
  .wb-embed .card-chk{top:2.6in;right:-.2in;width:1.65in;transform:rotate(9deg);}
  .wb-embed .card-chk .ci{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:7.8pt;padding:2px 0;}
  .wb-embed .card-chk .ci .b{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--mint);flex:0 0 auto;position:relative;}
  .wb-embed .card-chk .ci .b::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:3px;top:1px;width:4px;height:6px;border:solid #fff;border-width:0 2px 2px 0;transform:rotate(40deg);}
  .wb-embed .card-serp{top:5.3in;right:.65in;width:2.3in;transform:rotate(-3deg);}
  .wb-embed .card-serp .url{font-size:6.4pt;color:var(--mint);margin-bottom:2px;}
  .wb-embed .card-serp .t{font-size:8.4pt;color:var(--blue);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:3px;}
  .wb-embed .card-serp .d{font-size:7pt;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .wb-embed .cover2-base{background:var(--surface);padding:.4in .85in;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;position:relative;z-index:2;height:1.4in;}
  .wb-embed .wordmark{font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:800;font-size:14pt;}
  .wb-embed .wordmark .seo{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--indigo),var(--cyan));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
  .wb-embed .cover2-stats{display:flex;gap:20px;}
  .wb-embed .c2-stat{text-align:right;}
  .wb-embed .c2-stat b{display:block;font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:800;color:var(--indigo);font-size:11pt;}
  .wb-embed .c2-stat small{font-size:6.6pt;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;}

  /* thumb frames that host wb-embed content at real-page fidelity, scaled to fit the sales page */
  .wb-cover-thumb{--wbs:.4;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:22px;width:calc(816px * var(--wbs));height:calc(1056px * var(--wbs));flex:0 0 auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 30px 60px rgba(16,21,43,.35));}
  .wb-cover-thumb .wb-embed{width:816px;transform:scale(var(--wbs));transform-origin:top left;}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .wb-cover-thumb{--wbs:.33;} }
  @media (max-width:520px){ .wb-cover-thumb{--wbs:.29;margin:0 auto;} }

  .wb-thumb{--wbs:.7;--wn:700px;--hn:480px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;width:min(calc(var(--wn) * var(--wbs)), 88vw);height:calc(var(--hn) * var(--wbs));border-radius:18px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 20px 44px rgba(16,21,43,.14);border:1px solid var(--line);flex:0 0 auto;}
  .wb-thumb .wb-embed{width:var(--wn);transform:scale(var(--wbs));transform-origin:top left;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;}
  .wb-thumb .wb-embed-pad{padding:24px;padding-top:104px;}
  .wb-thumb .wb-fade{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:60px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,255,255,0), #fff);pointer-events:none;}
  .wb-thumb .wb-tag{position:absolute;top:13px;left:13px;z-index:5;background:rgba(16,21,43,.82);color:#fff;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.64rem;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 11px;border-radius:999px;}
  @media (max-width:640px){ .wb-thumb{--wbs:.56;} }
  @media (max-width:400px){ .wb-thumb{--wbs:.44;} }
  /* stacked-paper depth treatment for the two payoff pages (90-day plan / final plan) */
  .thumb-stack{position:relative;display:inline-block;}
  .thumb-stack::before,.thumb-stack::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;z-index:0;}
  .thumb-stack::before{transform:rotate(-1.6deg) translate(-5px,7px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(16,21,43,.08);}
  .thumb-stack::after{transform:rotate(1.8deg) translate(6px,4px);box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(16,21,43,.07);}
  .thumb-stack .wb-thumb{position:relative;z-index:1;}
  .thumb-stack.block{display:block;width:100%;}

  /* ===== Problem: asymmetric split, scattered chaos → order ===== */
  .problem-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:56px;align-items:center;}
  .problem-split > div{min-width:0;}
  .problem-split .lede{margin-left:0;margin-right:0;}
  .problem-visual{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;}
  .search-mock{width:100%;max-width:420px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(16,21,43,.12);overflow:hidden;}
  .search-mock-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:18px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .search-mock-bar span{font-size:1rem;color:var(--ink);font-weight:500;}
  .search-mock-bar .cursor{display:inline-block;width:1.5px;height:17px;background:var(--indigo);margin-left:2px;vertical-align:-3px;}
  .search-suggestions{padding:6px 0;}
  .sg-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 20px;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .sg-row svg{flex:0 0 auto;opacity:.55;}
  .sg-row b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;}
  .search-mock-caption{margin-top:18px;font-size:.86rem;color:var(--ink-soft);text-align:center;}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .problem-split{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px;} }
  .search-flow{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:22px;max-width:460px;}
  .sf-step{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;text-align:center;flex:1;}
  .sf-icon{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--indigo-bg);color:var(--indigo);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .sf-step span{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.3;}
  .sf-arrow{color:var(--line);font-size:1.1rem;flex:0 0 auto;margin-top:10px;}

  /* ===== 9-stage system diagram ===== */
  .sys-track{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:60px;flex-wrap:wrap;row-gap:32px;}
  .sys-track::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:23px;left:3%;right:3%;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--indigo),var(--cyan));z-index:0;}
  .sys-node{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;text-align:center;padding:0 4px;}
  .sys-dot{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:2.5px solid var(--indigo);color:var(--indigo);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.92rem;}
  .sys-node.final .sys-dot{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--indigo),var(--cyan));border-color:transparent;color:#fff;width:52px;height:52px;font-size:1.3rem;}
  .sys-label{margin-top:10px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.3;}
  .sys-node.final .sys-label{color:var(--ink);font-weight:800;}
  @media (max-width:900px){
    .sys-track{justify-content:flex-start;column-gap:8px;}
    .sys-track::before{display:none;}
    .sys-node{flex:0 0 calc(33.333% - 6px);}
  }

  /* ===== Two-worked-example diagrams: Pinterest Trends + Board Architecture ===== */
  .dual-diagram{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px;margin-top:64px;}
  .diagram-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:26px 24px 22px;text-align:left;}
  .diagram-card h4{font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .diagram-card .dc-note{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:16px;}
  .diagram-card svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;}
  .diagram-legend{display:flex;gap:16px;margin-top:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .diagram-legend span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:600;}
  .diagram-legend i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;display:inline-block;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .dc-callout{margin-top:16px;background:var(--mint-bg);border-left:3px solid var(--mint);border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;padding:10px 14px;font-size:.8rem;color:#0a5c53;}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .dual-diagram{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }

  /* ===== Built gallery ===== */
  .gallery-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:28px;justify-content:center;margin-top:8px;}
  .gallery-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;max-width:calc(var(--wn,700px) * var(--wbs,.62));}
  .gallery-item h4{font-size:.98rem;text-align:center;}
  .gallery-item p{font-size:.84rem;color:var(--ink-soft);text-align:center;max-width:280px;margin:0;}

  /* ===== Ask AI section ===== */
  .copilot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:52px;align-items:center;}
  .copilot-grid > div{min-width:0;}
  .copilot-note{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:22px 26px;margin-top:18px;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .copilot-note b{color:var(--ink);}

  /* ===== Scattered advice -> one plan (simplified) ===== */
  .scatter-plan{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;gap:32px;align-items:center;margin-top:48px;}
  .sp-sources{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;align-content:start;}
  .sp-source{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:13px 14px;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:.86rem;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .sp-dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .sp-arrow-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-align:center;}
  .sp-label{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-soft);white-space:nowrap;}
  .sp-label-final{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#c23c14,#0f766e);color:#fff;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:999px;}
  .sp-arrow-big{color:var(--line);font-size:1.9rem;line-height:1;}
  .sp-result{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:30px 26px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 20px 44px rgba(16,21,43,.1);}
  .sp-result .sr-icon{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#c23c14,#0f766e);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 14px;box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(79,70,229,.28);}
  .sp-result b{display:block;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .sp-result .sr-sub{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .sp-tags{margin-top:16px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:700;}
  @media (max-width:800px){
    .scatter-plan{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px;}
    .sp-arrow-col{flex-direction:row;justify-content:center;}
    .sp-arrow-big{transform:rotate(90deg);}
  }

  /* ===== finished artifact ===== */
  .finished-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:32px;align-items:start;}
  .finished-grid > div{min-width:0;}
  .finished-grid .wb-thumb{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;}

  /* ===== fit split (who it's for), reused pattern ===== */
  .fit-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;gap:56px;align-items:start;}
  .fit-split > div{min-width:0;}
  .fit-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;align-items:stretch;}
  .fit-usecase{border-radius:var(--radius);padding:24px 22px;border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%;box-sizing:border-box;}
  .fit-usecase .fu-icon{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.6);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .fit-usecase p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0;flex:1 1 auto;}
  .fit-usecase b{display:block;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px;}
  .not-for{margin-top:22px;padding:18px 20px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);}
  .not-for h4{margin-bottom:8px;}
  .not-for ul{margin:0;padding-left:20px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.88rem;}

  /* ===== Price ===== */
  .price-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:40px 44px 34px;margin:16px auto 0;max-width:600px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(16,21,43,.1);}
  .price-list{list-style:none;margin:0 0 22px;padding:0;text-align:left;}
  .price-list li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bg-alt);font-size:.96rem;}
  .price-list li:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .price-list .chk2{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--mint-bg);color:var(--mint);font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .price-amount{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--indigo-bg),var(--cyan-bg));border-radius:16px;padding:26px 20px 30px;margin-bottom:22px;}
  .price-amount span{font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.84rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .price-amount b{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-size:clamp(3rem,6vw,3.8rem);color:var(--indigo);line-height:1;}
  .price-amount .sub{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:600;margin-top:8px;}
  .delivery-note{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;background:var(--bg-alt);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;margin-top:22px;font-size:.84rem;color:var(--ink-soft);text-align:left;}

  /* ===== Ladder ===== */
  .ladder{display:flex;gap:0;margin:20px auto 0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;max-width:760px;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(16,21,43,.05);}
  .ladder-step{flex:1;padding:30px 28px;background:var(--surface);position:relative;}
  .ladder-step + .ladder-step{border-left:1px solid var(--line);}
  .ladder-step.active{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--indigo-bg),#fff 70%);}
  .ladder-step .ls-tag{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--indigo);margin-bottom:10px;}
  .ladder-step.step-analyze .ls-tag{color:var(--cyan);}
  .ladder-step .ls-price{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:1.7rem;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px;}
  .ladder-step p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0 0 16px;}
  @media (max-width:700px){ .ladder{flex-direction:column;} .ladder-step + .ladder-step{border-left:none;border-top:1px solid var(--line);} }

  /* FAQ */
  .faq-list{max-width:740px;margin:0 auto;}
  details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:18px 2px;}
  details summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-size:1rem;}
  details summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}
  details summary::after{content:"+";font-size:1.3rem;color:var(--indigo);font-weight:400;flex:0 0 auto;}
  details[open] summary::after{content:"–";}
  details p{margin-top:10px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.94rem;}

  /* Final CTA */
  .final-cta{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#a93312,#c23c14 45%,#0f766e);color:#fff;text-align:center;padding:96px 0;}
  .final-cta h2{color:#fff;}
  .final-cta .lede{margin:0 auto 30px;color:#efeaff;}

  .final-proof{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;margin:0 auto 36px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .fp-cover{width:112px;height:144px;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#000 0%,#c23c14 38%,#0e7fa6 78%,#0f766e 100%);box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(16,21,43,.32);padding:14px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;transform:rotate(-4deg);}
  .fp-cover span{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:700;color:#bcd7ff;font-size:.54rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;}
  .fp-cover b{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;color:#fff;font-size:.76rem;line-height:1.22;}
  .fp-page{width:96px;height:130px;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 16px 32px rgba(16,21,43,.22);padding:11px;transform:rotate(3deg);}
  .fp-page.p2{transform:rotate(-3deg);}
  .fp-page .fpl{height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--line);margin-bottom:7px;}
  .fp-page .fpl.short{width:60%;}
  .fp-page .fpchk{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-bottom:7px;}
  .fp-page .fpchk span{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:2px;border:1.3px solid var(--indigo);flex:0 0 auto;}
  .fp-page .fpchk i{height:5px;flex:1;border-radius:3px;background:var(--line);}
  .final-tags{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 26px;}
  .ftag{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 16px;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.8rem;color:#fff;}

  footer{padding:36px 0;font-size:.84rem;color:var(--ink-soft);background:var(--surface);border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  footer .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;}
  footer a{text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--line);}

  @media (max-width:980px){
    .copilot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .finished-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  }
  @media (max-width:900px){
    .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:center;}
    .hero .hero-actions{justify-content:center;}
    .hero .lede{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}
    .nav-links{display:none;}
    header.site .wrap{grid-template-columns:auto auto;}
    .fit-split{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px;}
    .fit-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  }
  @media (max-width:560px){
    section{padding:60px 0;}
    .fit-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .price-card{padding:32px 24px 28px;}
    .gallery-item{max-width:100%;}
    header.site .wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;padding-top:12px;padding-bottom:12px;}
    header.site .btn{width:100%;text-align:center;box-sizing:border-box;}
  }

  /* ===== Real Pinterest search recreation ===== */
  .pin-mock{width:100%;max-width:460px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(16,21,43,.12);overflow:hidden;}
  .pin-mock-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:11px 14px;background:#f5f7fc;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .pin-mock-bar .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#d3d7e6;}
  .pin-mock-bar .url{margin-left:6px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;}
  .pin-mock-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;padding:10px;}
  .pin-mock-grid .pmg-item{border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;aspect-ratio:2/3;}
  .pin-mock-grid .pmg-item img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;}
  .pin-mock-grid span{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:1;padding:10px 10px 12px;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.78rem;color:#fff;line-height:1.28;text-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.4);background:linear-gradient(to top, rgba(10,12,26,.78) 0%, rgba(10,12,26,.2) 55%, transparent 78%);}
  .pin-mock-caption{padding:10px 14px 14px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ink-soft);border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .pin-mock-caption b{color:var(--ink);}

  /* ===== Signature Pin anatomy (real photo + callouts) ===== */
  .pin-anat{max-width:340px;margin:0 auto;}
  .pin-anat-photo{position:relative;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(16,21,43,.18);aspect-ratio:2/3;}
  .pin-anat-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;}
  .pin-anat-overlay-title{position:absolute;left:12px;right:60px;bottom:14px;background:rgba(16,21,43,.72);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.84rem;color:#fff;line-height:1.25;}
  .pin-anat-savebtn{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;background:var(--indigo);color:#fff;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.72rem;padding:6px 16px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(79,70,229,.4);}
  .pin-anat-badge{position:absolute;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c23c14,#0f766e);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.8rem;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(16,21,43,.35);z-index:3;}
  .pin-anat-meta{margin-top:18px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:4px 18px;background:var(--surface);}
  .pam-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);}
  .pam-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .pam-num{flex:0 0 auto;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c23c14,#0f766e);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.76rem;margin-top:1px;}
  .pam-row b{display:block;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:3px;}
  .pam-row span{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink);}
  .pam-tag{display:inline-block;background:var(--indigo-bg);color:var(--indigo-dark);font-weight:700;font-size:.8rem;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 12px;}

  /* ===== Category fit grid ===== */
  .cat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:8px;}
  .cat-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:22px;}
  .cat-card .cat-rank{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--indigo);color:#fff;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.78rem;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .cat-card h4{font-size:1.02rem;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .cat-card p{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0 0 10px;}
  .cat-card .cat-stat{display:inline-block;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--mint);background:var(--mint-bg);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .cat-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;} }
  @media (max-width:560px){ .cat-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }

  /* ===== Case studies ===== */
  .case-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px;margin-top:8px;}
  .case-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:28px;}
  .case-card .case-tag{display:inline-block;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mint);background:var(--mint-bg);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 11px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .case-card h4{font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .case-card .case-niche{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:16px;}
  .case-metrics{display:flex;gap:20px;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .case-metrics div{flex:1;}
  .case-metrics b{display:block;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:1.3rem;color:var(--indigo);}
  .case-metrics span{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .case-card p.case-note{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0 0 10px;}
  .case-card a{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--indigo);font-weight:600;}
  .case-disclaimer{max-width:740px;margin:28px auto 0;text-align:center;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  @media (max-width:800px){ .case-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }

  /* ===== Pinterest-native accent + pinboard motif (not used on other Scrolly pages) ===== */
  :root{ --terracotta:var(--indigo); --terracotta-bg:var(--indigo-bg); }
  .section-board{background:var(--ink);color:#e7e9f5;}
  .section-board h2,.section-board .eyebrow{color:#fff;}
  .section-board .eyebrow{color:#e6dcff;}
  .section-board .lede{color:#b6bcd8;}
  .pinboard{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:44px;}
  .pinboard .pin{border-radius:16px;padding:20px 12px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;gap:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);min-height:128px;height:100%;box-sizing:border-box;}
  .pinboard .pin .picon{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--terracotta);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .pinboard .pin span{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:.78rem;color:#e7e9f5;line-height:1.3;}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .pinboard{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);} }
  @media (max-width:560px){ .pinboard{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);} }
  /* ===== Timeline (light bg) ===== */
  .tl2-track{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:56px;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .tl2-track::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:22px;left:2%;right:2%;height:2px;background:var(--line);z-index:0;}
